entries.subject: Orbit
entries.finding: Kruse et al. 2019 (2019ApJS..244...11K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KRUSE_ET_AL__2019): P 7.065 d; Crossfield et al. 2016 (2016ApJS..226....7C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname CROSSFIELD_ET_AL__2016): a/R* derived from its semi-major axis 0.0591 au and stellar radius 0.491 solar radii; Vanderburg et al. 2016 (2016ApJS..222...14V), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname VANDERBURG_ET_AL__2016): inclination derived from its impact parameter 0.57 with the orbit's a/R* 25.8827 (Winn 2010, eq. 7); No archive row states an eccentricity; the orbit is taken as circular; Kruse et al. 2019 (2019ApJS..244...11K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KRUSE_ET_AL__2019): transit mid-time 2456982.7863 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 331 min); Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north)..
